verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents REST APIs and a SQL API, and publishes official OpenAPI-compliant specs with importable Postman collections. That gives runnable, explorable API calls, but only through an external tool like Postman rather than an interactive reference in the docs. Probes for an OpenAPI spec at standard docs paths all returned 404, and no evidence shows a built-in try-it console. Missing for 10: interactive in-docs API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, OpenAPI spec served from the docs site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
